The cost of doing business (permalink) The most important part of any law, rule or policy isn't what it permits or prohibits – it's whether you can enforce the law at all. After all, as odious as a law that forbids people from thinking mean thoughts about Trump would be, it would also be completely unenforceable, and would ultimately just not be very important, except as a symbol of Trump's evil.
